description: The de-esser as a device: a frequency, an over-body level, a ratio and a range, its models (the split, band and wide band de-essers of @audio/dynamics-deesser, which tell an s by the highs over the voice's body), the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the response a state draws and the source of the worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
name: deesser-device
